name: VibeFigma
summary: Open-source CLI, API and Claude Code skill that convert Figma designs into React/TypeScript components with Tailwind CSS.
description: Converts Figma frames into React/TypeScript components using the official Figma API, with automatic Tailwind CSS class generation (enabled by default) and optional AI-powered code cleanup. Usable as an interactive CLI, a direct command with a Figma access token, a Claude Code skill, or a REST API server; the open-source core of VibeFlow UI.
contains: converts Figma frames to React/TypeScript components
Tailwind CSS class generation enabled by default
usage via interactive CLI, direct command, env var, Claude Code skill or REST API
REST API server with docs in docs/API.md
AGPL-3.0 licensed open-source core of VibeFlow UI
